answers.p1: They are named with a UTC timestamp like 20260502T101500.
answers.p2: snap/manifest.py writes the manifest, called MANIFEST.json.
answers.p3: Tests pass timestamps in rather than sleeping to get distinct ones.
answers.p6: Only folders matching [0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}; stray folders and files are never touched.
answers.p8: First restore, then the verify command that checks MANIFEST.json, then the cron example.
